odia: ବୋହି ଗଲା ପାଣି ଯାଉ ତେଣିକି, ବନ୍ଧେଇଲା ପାଣି ରହୁ ଅଟକି
title: What has flowed, what remains
literal_meaning: Let the water that has flowed away go that way; let the dammed water remain held.
explanation: The two wishes face different water: what has already gone and what can remain contained. Our reading turns attention from recovering every loss to keeping what is still available. This is an editorial application of the contrast, not a promise that every loss can be repaired by restraint.
meaning_odia: ଦୁଇଟି ଇଚ୍ଛା ଦୁଇ ଅବସ୍ଥାର ପାଣିକୁ ନେଇ—ଯାହା ବୋହିଗଲା ଓ ଯାହା ଅଟକି ରହିଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ହରାଇଥିବା ଜିନିଷ ଫେରାଇବାଠାରୁ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଏବେ ଥିବା ଜିନିଷକୁ ରଖିବା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଫେରେ। ଏହା ବିରୋଧଟିର ଆମର ପ୍ରୟୋଗ; ସଂଯମରେ ସବୁ କ୍ଷତି ଭରଣା ହେବ ବୋଲି ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our reading distinguishes a past loss from what can still be kept.
odia_summary: ବିତିଥିବା କ୍ଷତି ଓ ରଖିପାରିବା ଜିନିଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆମ ପଢ଼ାର ତଫାତ।
usage_example: Original imagined example: ବର୍ଷାରେ ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରର ଗୋଟିଏ ଦିନ ବାତିଲ ହେଲା। ଆୟୋଜକ ସେଦିନକୁ ନେଇ ଅନୁତାପ କରୁଥିବାବେଳେ ସାଙ୍ଗ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ କହିଲେ, “ଆସନ୍ତା ଦୁଇଦିନର ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା କରିବା।” / Rain cancels one day of a reading programme. While an organiser regrets it, a friend recalls the saying: “Let us arrange the two days still ahead.” This application is invented.
cultural_context: The verb’s dam-building sense supports the water image. No particular river, engineering method, conservation custom or practical water-management instruction is documented here.
